title: Modulation of the RNA-sensing RIG/MAVS pathway bypasses resistance to hypomethylating agents in acute myeloid leukemia.
snippet: DNA hypomethylating agents (HMAs) such as 5-azacytidine (5-AZA) are a cornerstone in the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia (AML), but development of resistance represents a major clinical challenge. title: Association of Gut Microbiome Dynamics With Systemic Inflammation and Disease-Free Survival in Osteosarcoma Patients.
snippet: Gut microbiota (GM) is increasingly recognised as a key modulator of cancer development, progression, and treatment response. However, clinical studies remain limited, especially in osteosarcoma (OS), the most common bone cancer in children and adolescents.
